task: controlled single-image happy portrait style probe

review.method: temporary nearest-neighbor downscale for inspection; review copy removed
review.observations: At 64x64, palette and pixel texture remain close to original. Mouth corners and cheek warmth rise slightly, but happy expression reads subtle; eye expression stays close to neutral. No hard black eyeliner; eye shading remains dark enough to stand out.

prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one complete 64×64 pixel-art NPC portrait prototype
Input image: Image 1 is the actual original portrait and sole style/identity source. Do not use other references.
Primary request: edit this same portrait into a gently happy expression.
Subject: same woman with exactly the same identity, head size, face shape, hair silhouette, framing, skin tone, and background.
Style/medium: preserve the original’s naturally soft, limited color palette, gentle skin-tone steps, and small, understated pixel-art clusters. Keep the original’s native 64×64 visual character. No hard contrast increase.
Composition/framing: one complete portrait matching original bounds exactly.
Lighting/mood: warm, clearly friendly happiness. Eyes feel kind and relaxed. Slight cheek lift. Mouth closed with clearly raised natural corners.
Constraints: change expression only. Preserve soft transitions and limited tonal range. Smile must read clearly at 64×64 without teeth. Keep eyes and eyebrows natural, delicate, and consistent with original pixel style.
Avoid: black or hard eyeliner, harsh eyebrows, dark eye shadows, smudged or blurry eyes, heavy contrast, giant grin, visible teeth, open mouth, face reshaping, head-size change, hair changes, added pixels outside portrait, patches, crops, overlays, sharpening, filters, compositing, text, objects, borders.
